$comment: Single source of the Basilisk C language knowledge used by every editor.
After editing, run: python3 tools/generate.py   (CI runs --check).
highlight: word lists, by category; 'prefixes' match any identifier starting with them.
detect: what makes a .c/.h file Basilisk C (any line matching, in the first max_lines).
docs: hover/completion documentation of built-in constructs (markdown). snippets: LSP snippets.

event_condition.$comment: only highlighted on `event` lines (nano can't do that and skips them)

foreach.doc:
Loops over all the leaf cells of the grid (in parallel with OpenMP/MPI).

Inside the loop: `x`, `y`, `z` are the coordinates of the cell centre, `Delta` is the cell size, `point` the current `Point`, and fields are accessed through stencils: `s[]`, `s[1]`, `s[-1,0]`, `s[0,1]`...

Global accumulations must be declared with `reduction(+:sum)` (also `min`, `max`).

foreach_face.doc: Loops over the faces of the leaf cells. The body is written for the *x* direction and automatically rotated for the other directions (as with `foreach_dimension()`); `foreach_face(x)` restricts the loop to the *x* faces. Use it to update `face vector` fields: `uf.x[]` is the value on the face between `[-1]` and `[]`.

foreach_vertex.doc: Loops over the vertices of the leaf cells (for `vertex` fields).

foreach_dimension.doc: Repeats the following statement (or function definition) for each dimension, rotating `x`→`y`→`z` in component names (`.x`, `_x`) and stencil indices.

foreach_level.doc: Loops over all the cells at level `l` of the tree.

foreach_level_or_leaf.doc: Loops over the cells at level `l` and the leaf cells coarser than `l`.

foreach_coarse_level.doc: Loops over the non-leaf cells at level `l`.

foreach_leaf.doc: Loops over the leaf cells (equivalent to `foreach()`).

foreach_cell.doc: Depth-first traversal of the whole tree, starting from the root. Use `continue` to skip the children of the current cell and `is_leaf(cell)` to detect leaves.

foreach_child.doc: Loops over the children of the current cell.

foreach_neighbor.doc: Loops over the neighbours of the current cell, within a stencil of half-width `n`.

foreach_boundary.doc: Loops over the cells adjacent to boundary `b` (e.g. `left`).

foreach_point.sig: foreach_point (double x, double y, double z) statement
foreach_point.doc: Executes the statement on the leaf cell containing the point (x, y, z).

foreach_fine_to_coarse.doc: Loops over the non-leaf cells, from the finest to the coarsest level.

foreach_block.doc: Loops over the blocks/layers of block data (multilayer solver).

foreach_layer.doc: Loops over the layers (multilayer solver). Inside, `point.l` is the layer index.

event.doc:
Defines an event, executed by `run()` when its conditions are met.

Conditions: `i = 0`, `i++`, `i += 10`, `t = 0`, `t += 0.1`, `t <= 10`, `t = end`, `first`, `last`, `t = {0, 1, 2}`... Events with the same name as an existing event (e.g. `init`, `logfile`, `adapt`) are added to it; returning 1 stops the run.

reduction.doc: Declares a parallel reduction for a `foreach` loop. `op` is `+`, `min` or `max`; `var` is a variable or an array `var[:n]`.

scalar.doc: A scalar field. Global or local declarations `scalar s[];` allocate the field (local fields are freed automatically at the end of the scope); `scalar s = new scalar;` allocates dynamically. Values are accessed inside `foreach` loops as `s[]`, `s[1,0]`...

face.doc: Qualifier: a `face vector` is staggered on cell faces (`uf.x[]` lives on the face between `[-1]` and `[]`).

vertex.doc: Qualifier: a `vertex scalar` is defined on cell vertices.

symmetric.doc: Qualifier: a symmetric tensor (`T.x.y` and `T.y.x` share storage).

new.sig: new scalar | new vector | new face vector ...
new.doc: Dynamically allocates a new field; free it with `delete ({s});`.

trace.doc: Marks the following function for profiling (`-DTRACE`).

macro.doc: Basilisk macro: a function-like definition inlined by qcc, which can take a code block as its last argument.

Delta.doc: Size of the current cell (inside `foreach`-type loops).

x.doc: *x*-coordinate of the current cell (or face) centre.

y.doc: *y*-coordinate of the current cell (or face) centre.

z.doc: *z*-coordinate of the current cell (or face) centre.

level.doc: Level of the current cell (inside loops).

fine.doc: Value of field `s` in child cell (i, j, k).

coarse.doc: Value of field `s` in the parent cell.

neighbor.doc: The neighbouring `Point` at offset (i, j, k).

in.doc: Iterates over the fields of a list.

last.doc: Event condition: last (executed after all other events of the same name).

end.doc: Event condition: the end of the run.
